The "Real Characters" category comprises green sectors labeled "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", and "Influencers". The "Virtual Characters" category is further divided into light blue sectors labeled "Game Characters", "Novel Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Movie Characters", and "Comic Characters". The diagram includes no legend, but some sectors have visually distinct colors; pink highlights the "Custom Characters" sector, which is contained within and appears to be a subset of the "Real Characters" category. Notably, the sectors within each main category appear to be arranged in no specific order by size.
model_annotations.English: The chart represents a hierarchical categorization of character types, divided into two main categories: Custom Characters and Real Characters. The Custom Characters category is further divided into Virtual Characters and other subcategories. There are 16 slices in total. The Virtual Characters category is comprised of six slices: Game Characters, Novel Characters, Teleplay Characters, Movie Characters, and Comic Characters, and an unlabeled slice; the largest slice, Comic Characters, is approximately 31%, and the smallest, unlabeled slice, appears to be around 4-5%. The Real Characters category includes nine slices: Musicians, Writers, Athletes, Artists, Scientists, Influencers, Actors, and three unlabeled slices; the largest slice, Actors, appears to be around 18%, and the smallest slice, appears to be around 4-5%. The chart includes a legend and percentage labels are not shown inside the slices; however, some slices seem to have a slightly darker shade of color to differentiate them, but it is not clear if this is a visual emphasis. The slices appear to be ordered in a clockwise direction, starting from the top.
model_annotations.German: This diagram presents a hierarchical representation of character categories, comprising two concentric circles. The inner circle is divided into two segments: "Real Characters" in green and "Virtual Characters" in blue. The outer circle is further divided into 10 segments, each representing a subcategory of "Virtual Characters", labeled as follows: "Comic Characters" (light blue), "Movie Characters" (light blue), "Teleplay Characters" (light blue), "Novel Characters" (light blue), "Game Characters" (light blue), and "Custom Characters" (pink). The "Real Characters" segment is subdivided into 8 smaller sections, listed in a clockwise direction as: "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", "Influencers", with each section assigned a distinct green shade. The diagram does not include a legend; however, the segments are visually distinguished by color and labeling. The subcategories of "Virtual Characters" appear to be arranged in a clockwise direction, although this observation is not explicitly stated.
